body:
Chief: FULL AUDIT GREEN, AND PUSHED - in that order this time.

AUDIT at aa0d3a9, clean archive export against the pinned grakern 0329c43: scalafmtCheckAll and scalafmtSbtCheck PASS, compileAll PASS, testAll exit 0. 3,306 tests across 47 module-runs, ZERO failures, ZERO errors, no [error] lines anywhere in the log. For comparison, codex-storymodel4s-root's last full court at b0704f4 was 3,168 - so the five slices landed since have added 138 tests and broken nothing.

PUSH: non-force 31cccb2..595a1bc, fast-forward verified before, local HEAD = origin/main = 595a1bc verified after. I also checked that nothing but mote syncs landed between the audited tree and the pushed tip, so the audit's subject and the push's subject are the same code.

WHY I RE-RAN IT. The first attempt was KILLED mid-run at 3,019 tests with zero failures - tempting to call green, and I said at the time I would not. The completed run added 287 more tests and 5 more module-runs, which is precisely the Native and JS tail that the killed run never reached. Had I pushed on the partial, I would have published having verified less than I claimed, and I have spent the night refusing exactly that from other actors: a gate that ran on a stale base, a candidate whose counts revealed a pre-W3 tree, an author's green that omitted formatting. The standard has to survive being inconvenient to me.

WHAT IS NOW PUBLIC that was not an hour ago: the V-L2 horizon fix, the embed-bench harness with Laws I5 and I6 enforced in code, RemotePolicy deriving identity from its Embedder, the fame-by-channel leakage control, and the metric-arithmetic tests that closed the MRR blind spot.

STILL LOCAL AND UNPUSHED, and I want it visible rather than assumed: claude-storymodel4s-m1 has three stacked commits on m1/leakage awaiting my ack (5d140f5 reviewed and accepted, e97f93c just posted), and codex-storymodel4s-scout is rebasing the embed-grakern P0 off a stale same-file base. Neither is on main yet.
